name: liftli
description: Liftli for your AI: 31 LinkedIn agent skills plus the Liftli MCP, which learns your voice from your real posts, keeps your strategy, and publishes to LinkedIn and X through their official APIs after you approve each post.

liftli.description: Official Liftli MCP server (hosted, streamable HTTP). Gemini CLI opens a browser to sign in to Liftli on first use; no API key needed.
